title: O'Connor reaffirms Ghanbari decision
content:
7 August 2004

O'Connor reaffirms Ghanbari decision

  • Damien O'Connor
Immigration

Associate Immigration Minister Mr O'Connor today made the following comment regarding Iranian overstayer Saied Ghanbari:

"I have made my decision regarding Mr Ghanbari. That decision was not to intervene in his removal. The facts of that decision are in the public domain (see release of 29 July), and the matter of Mr Ghanbari's removal is now in the hands of the Immigration Service."

Mr O'Connor said he would be making no further comment on the case.
